title: Pretty color as long as I put nothing in them; however, the color gets lost when used to store jam & makes some jam look sickly
text:
Pretty color as long as I put nothing in them; however, the color gets lost when used to store jam & makes some jam look sickly. This review is for the [[ASIN:B01AAHHB9A Ball Regular Mouth Elite Collection Half Pint Jars, Blue (4-Pack)]].

I purchased these jars at Walmart for canning at a comparable price to Amazon. These jars are absolutely beautiful. I used them in the pint-sized section of my [[ASIN:B007QT4GO4 Prepworks by Progressive Reversible Stainless Steel Canning Rack]] to can some jam. Because they are tall and narrow, they do tend to slip around on the canning rack so beware of that if using the same rack. What I really do not like is that once the jam is in the jar, the color of the jar gets lost. It made my peach jam look sickly and although the blueberry jam looked great, it did not look any better than in a clear jar. For this reason, I would not spend the extra money to buy these.

Note that I also purchased the [[ASIN:B01AAHHB5E Ball Jelly Elite Collection Jam Jar (4 Pack), 8 oz, Clear]] as well and love those jars and would purchase that version of the Elite collection but not these colored ones. In addition, I also purchased [[ASIN:B001DIZ1NO Ball Mason "PINT" Jars Wide-Mouth Can or Freeze - 12pk (by Jarden Home Brands)]], which I would purchase again. I love the wide mouth version the best because they can be put in the freezer. In addition, I purchased a dozen Kerr Wide Mouth Half-Pint Mason Jars from Walmart which are similar to the Ball Wide-Mouth Jars in that they can be used for freezing. I also love those.
